question: Assume today is 2026-10-27. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate BYD Company Limited's operating revenue for the three months July-September 2026 (the third quarter alone, not January-September), in Chinese yuan (CNY), as it will be first reported in BYD's unaudited third quarterly report (key accounting data table, 'The Reporting Period' column).

target.what: BYD Company Limited consolidated operating revenue (营业收入) for the three months 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30, as first reported in the 'The Reporting Period' column of the key accounting data table of BYD's unaudited Q3 2026 report (A-share/HKEX quarterly report), in CNY
target.publisher: BYD Company Limited (002594.SZ / 1211.HK), unaudited third quarterly report
target.cadence: quarterly (Q3 report; note BYD's A-share quarterly reports historically report Q3 as a standalone three-month column plus year-to-date)
target.caveats: Target is the single-quarter (three-month) figure, not the January-September cumulative; if the report only presents cumulative figures, the quarter must be derived by subtracting H1 from 9M. Consolidated group revenue includes automobiles and related products, phone components/assembly (BYD Electro

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
